proofs.title: Hanson–Wright
proofs.rationale: Decoupling is the central conceptual bridge in this proof: it turns dependent quadratic cross terms into a bilinear form with independent inputs. Conditioning on one input then makes the other a linear form, so the prepared subgaussian bound becomes usable.
proofs.selection_provenance: Selected by a dedicated LLM agent for this reading edition, 11 October 2026.

proofs.title: Covariance estimation
proofs.rationale: Scalar concentration and uniformization supply the rate. In the candidates checked here, Frobenius control loses √r; a direct-coordinate proof removes whitening at the same n-rate. No net-free impossibility or measured search lower bound is claimed.
proofs.selection_provenance: Editorial AI selection authored with knowledge of these ablations; no independent blinded selection call is recorded.

proofs.title: Dimension reduction for Boolean functions
proofs.rationale: Exponential concentration and simultaneous control are the two structural moves. The literature-assisted Bernoulli alternative improves the ε rate, so additive Hoeffding is replaceable. Merely analyzing one pair or using Chebyshev does not meet the requested guarantee.
proofs.selection_provenance: Editorial AI selection authored with knowledge of these ablations; no independent blinded selection call is recorded.

proofs.title: Slepian’s inequality
proofs.rationale: The interpolation bridge and the orthant test supply the full stochastic comparison. The broad interpolation ban has no successful replacement among the candidates studied. A density-free integration-by-parts derivation still uses interpolation and therefore is not a success under that ban.
proofs.selection_provenance: Editorial AI selection authored with knowledge of these ablations; no independent blinded selection call is recorded.

proofs.title: Centering a subgaussian variable
proofs.rationale: The main local choice controls a centered exponential moment. Orlicz convexity replaces the square split at the same constant; a second-moment route replaces the mean estimate at a worse constant. These successful alternatives give no basis to claim an irreplaceable discovery bottleneck.
